tagline.zh-CN: 在 Windows 桌面上轻松查看当前 Codex 账号的额度与重置时间。
tagline.en: See your current Codex quota and reset times on the Windows desktop.

items.zh-CN: 显示 Codex 当前账号的 5 小时和每周额度、使用比例与重置时间。
items.en: Shows the current Codex account's five-hour and weekly limits, usage, and reset times.

items.zh-CN: 支持手动和自动刷新及本地偏好；胶囊态指标可切换使用比例与重置时间，托盘可切换显示形态、置顶状态和界面语言。
items.en: Supports manual and automatic refresh and saved preferences; capsule metrics can switch between usage and reset time, while the tray controls display mode, pinning, and language.

items.zh-CN: Windows 10 x64 可选用任务栏工具栏；Windows 11 可使用悬浮窗。
items.en: Windows 10 x64 can use the taskbar toolbar; Windows 11 can use the floating window.

items.zh-CN: Windows 10 任务栏悬停卡片显示五小时和周额度的剩余进度、已用比例与重置时间。
items.en: The Windows 10 taskbar hover card shows remaining progress, used percentages, and reset times for both quota windows.

items.zh-CN: 一个安装包提供简体中文和英文界面。
items.en: One installer includes Simplified Chinese and English interfaces.

items.zh-CN: 需要 Windows 本机已有 Codex 登录；程序从当前用户的 .codex/auth.json 读取登录状态。
items.en: Codex must already be signed in on Windows; the app reads the current user's .codex/auth.json.

items.zh-CN: 认证令牌不会显示在界面或写入应用设置。
items.en: Authentication tokens are not shown in the interface or written to app settings.

items.zh-CN: 从下方最新版本页面下载 Windows x64 安装程序并运行；安装需要管理员权限。
items.en: Download the Windows x64 installer from the latest release and run it; administrator permission is required.

content.zh-CN:
### 紧凑显示 紧凑显示提供悬浮窗和任务栏两种形态。任务栏形态支持 Windows 10 x64。
悬浮窗紧凑显示任务栏紧凑显示
### 悬停查看额度详情 将鼠标悬停在任务栏额度上，可查看剩余比例、已用比例和重置时间。
简体中文English
### 悬浮窗设置 设置面板可调整自动刷新间隔、显示方式、主题，以及任务栏固定状态。 ![CQBar 设置面板](docs/images/settings-panel.png)
content.en:
### Compact display Compact display is available as a floating window or a taskbar toolbar. The taskbar toolbar supports Windows 10 x64.
Floating windowTaskbar toolbar
### Taskbar quota details Hover over a taskbar quota to see remaining progress, usage, and reset times.
简体中文English
### Floating window settings The settings panel controls the refresh interval, display mode, theme, and taskbar pinning state. ![CQBar settings panel](docs/images/settings-panel.png)

content.zh-CN:
需要 Windows、Node.js、Rust MSVC 工具链、Visual Studio C++ x64 构建工具和 Windows SDK。

开发运行：

~~~powershell
npm ci
npm run tauri:dev
~~~

构建 Windows x64 安装包：

~~~powershell
npm run release
~~~

安装包和 SHA-256 校验文件会生成在 release/。安装 DeskBand 需要管理员权限。发布脚本只在本地构建，不会自动上传安装包。
content.en:
Windows, Node.js, the Rust MSVC toolchain, Visual Studio C++ x64 build tools, and the Windows SDK are required.

Run the app in development:

~~~powershell
npm ci
npm run tauri:dev
~~~

Build the Windows x64 installer:

~~~powershell
npm run release
~~~

The installer and SHA-256 checksum file are written to release/. Installing the DeskBand requires administrator permission. The release script builds locally and does not upload the installer.
